_note: Narration script for the Team Leader people and passwords module (Team Leader guide section 10, Grant access and passwords, and section 9, People). Written by Claude from the guide, for the owner to review. Lee voice on eleven_v4, [calmly] prefix, two takes (scenes 1 to 4, then 5 to 8). DSY spelled D S Y in the prompt.

lines.head: Introduction
sentences: Adding people, and resetting passwords.
Who can sign in, and which team they're in.

lines.head: The approved list
sentences: Only people whose ambulance ID is on the approved list can make a DSY account.
Open Grant access, from the home page or the bottom of the dashboard.

lines.head: Adding IDs
sentences: Paste the IDs, one per line.
Add the name after each ID.
Choose Student or Facilitator, and the team.
Then tap Add to the list.

lines.head: Signing up
sentences: They can now sign up with that ID.
Sign-up only asks for the ID and a password.
The account takes the name you entered.
And they join the team when they sign up.

lines.head: Teams
sentences: Someone already signed up? Use Add to a team.
To take them off a team, use the People tab in the training app.
You can only choose teams in your own cluster.

lines.head: Passwords
sentences: Volunteers can't reset their own password.
So you do it.
Tap Reset password, and type a temporary one.
They sign in with it, and choose their own straight away.

lines.head: Take care
sentences: Never post a password in a group chat.
And Remove switches an account off.
Add them back to switch it on again.

lines.head: Summary
sentences: Add the ID, with the name.
Pick the team.
And tell them the password yourself.
